verses.pali: “Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, apariññātaṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati apariññātā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, those who haven’t completely understood mindfulness of the body haven’t completely understood freedom from death.

verses.pali: Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, pariññātaṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati pariññātā”ti.
verses.english: Those who have completely understood mindfulness of the body have completely understood freedom from death.”
